title: Welcome to the chessboard
objectives: Identify the board's orientation and the two sides

steps.text: This is a chessboard. It has 64 squares, alternating light and dark. For now, the board is shown from White's side: White's pieces begin at the bottom.
Each player controls one side: White pieces and Black pieces. White always moves first.

steps.prompt: Tap the square where White's king begins.

hints.text: Look for White's king. It's the tallest piece with a small cross on top.
It sits on White's back row, right of center.
One more look at that square.

feedback.d1: That's the queen's starting square — she stands right next to the king.
feedback.default: That's not the king's starting square. Look for the tallest piece with a small cross.
